title: Lewd Flags and Loading Screens (Miao, Alarielle, others)
author: Kerberos 2
description:
Wanted to finally collect these on LoversLab instead of them being scattered throughout the discord.

Contains separate files for the pictured banners for Miao and Alarielle's factions. As well as a loading screens "all in one" that contains images for the pictured factions. These come from a number of sources but mainly art by Endo/Lettie and in game screenshots by Crw0.

Better HD version of Alarielle's corrupted flag available from Readman on steam at <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3536009143>

[img https://www.loverslab.com/uploads/monthly_2025_07/alar.png.62b2c739cc99074bb9c13ed70041e1a0.png]

Personally I turn these mods on after reaching Corruption Stage 4 on Miao, or Corruption Stage 5 in Alarielle Temptation's Bloom.

These pair well with my steam mod Slaanesh UI theme for Miao Ying, Katarin, and Alarielle and I personally turn it on at the same time.

<https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3304325611>
